description: Output schema for the clinical text processing pipeline

text.description: The exact text span from the clinical note

start.description: Character offset start (inclusive) relative to note text

end.description: Character offset end (exclusive) relative to note text

type.description: Entity type from the terminology database

assertion.description: Clinical assertion status of the entity

resolved_code.description: Standardized code from the matched terminology entry

resolved_term.description: Canonical term from the matched terminology entry

similarity.description: Match confidence score (1.0 for exact match, <1.0 for approximate match)
